dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: A cluster of 3-5 prominent, irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures in the anterior-dorsal region exhibit sharp, light-toned perimeters; the edges transition from a deep-grey/black background to a high-intensity white/grey perimeter before returning to a dark-grey interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid, high-intensity punctate spots and asymmetrical light-pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily situated in the interstitial spaces between larger ring structures on the lower lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct macro-annuli in the upper-left quadrant form a scalene triangle with its longest axis oriented horizontally; a fourth prominent centroid located ventrally to this group creates a Y-shaped vertex configuration.
